data.rule: Do not expose exact component coordinates, terminal pins, wire colours or fuse IDs until a VIN-matched manufacturer document confirms them.
Do not embed or reprint OEM erWin diagrams or workshop photos in a distributed app without independent express redistribution permission.
An erWin flat rate is access permission for authorized repair use, not a license to redistribute OEM pages.
Never associate a wiring diagram to a model only from an observed DTC; verify VIN, engine, gearbox, market and equipment.
Never transfer a component position from a different engine, transmission or equipment variant without OEM matching.
Do not invent G/N/J designators, component part numbers, connector labels, pinouts, circuit diagrams or drawings.
Photos require verifiable license, author, source URL, modification and attribution metadata, plus vehicle-fitment review.
Do not perform tests that manipulate fuel pressure, move actuators or disturb electrical circuits without specific OEM-safe procedures.
Preserve source cases as individual observations; presence of a component or DTC in one car is not universal for a generation.
Manufacturer training SSP can clarify operating principles, not establish valid workshop pins, fuse values or repair tests.

data.policy: REQUIRED before asserting an exact harness/pinout or location.
Document title, revision/edition, type/engine applicability and exact page required.
No copied original diagrams in the distributed bundle absent grant of reuse rights.
Public availability, credit or journalist/editorial permission alone is NOT commercial app redistribution permission.
Confirm same vehicle generation, engine/part; own/licensed photo only.
Block publish if source, evidence, license, or image checksum missing.
